item.title: Inverness Cocktail Week Returns With 50+ Venues and Citywide Deals
item.description: Inverness Cocktail Week returns from 20 February to 1 March 2026, with 50 venues offering £5 to £7 cocktails, signature drinks and exclusive deals across bars and restaurants in the city centre.The post Inverness Cocktail Week Returns With 50+ Venues and Citywide Deals appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Scottish Budget Pledges Investment for Highlands Public Services
item.description: The Scottish Budget includes £5 million for the Belford Hospital project, £10 million for ferry services and record funding for Highland and Moray councils, alongside a new bus fare cap pilot in the Highlands and Islands.The post Scottish Budget Pledges Investment for Highlands Public Services appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A Rural Bungalow With Land and Sea Views in Tankerness
item.description: Set in Tankerness on Orkney Mainland, Gransetter offers a three bedroom bungalow within 9.6 acres, enjoying panoramic views over the Deer Sound and surrounding countryside, combining rural space with easy access to Kirkwall.The post A Rural Bungalow With Land and Sea Views in Tankerness appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Orkney Parasport Festival Returns as Registration Opens for Fifth Year
item.description: Registration has opened for Orkney’s fifth Parasport Festival at the Pickaquoy Centre in Kirkwall, offering inclusive rugby, athletics, archery, climbing and boccia for children with disabilities.The post Orkney Parasport Festival Returns as Registration Opens for Fifth Year appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Ministers Approve Chleansaid Wind Farm Grid Connection in Sutherland
item.description: Scottish Ministers have approved a 10.5km overhead line connecting Chleansaid Wind Farm to Dalchork substation near Lairg, enabling renewable power from Sutherland to feed into Scotland’s wider transmission network.The post Ministers Approve Chleansaid Wind Farm Grid Connection in Sutherland appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Ducati Formula 73 Revives a Legend for a New Generation
item.description: Ducati has unveiled the limited edition Formula 73, a numbered tribute to the iconic 750 Super Sport Desmo, blending classic 1970s racing heritage with modern engineering and electronics for 2026.The post Ducati Formula 73 Revives a Legend for a New Generation appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Wildflower Project Launched to Boost Biodiversity in Lerwick
item.description: New native wildflower sites at Breiwick Road and Rudda Court in Lerwick aim to boost biodiversity and support the endangered Shetland Bumblebee through a Nature Restoration Fund backed pilot project.The post Wildflower Project Launched to Boost Biodiversity in Lerwick appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Western Isles Council Proposes 9.5 Per Cent Council Tax Rise Ahead of Budget Decision
item.description: Comhairle nan Eilean Siar has proposed a 9.5 per cent council tax rise and use of reserves ahead of its 2026 to 2027 budget meeting, citing funding pressures and a projected £15.9 million shortfall.The post Western Isles Council Proposes 9.5 Per Cent Council Tax Rise Ahead of Budget Decision appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Lib Dems Urge Major Boost for Scotland’s Gaming Industry
item.description: Scottish Liberal Democrats have called for a major boost to Scotland’s £188 million gaming industry, proposing regional hubs, a Games Innovation Centre and stronger fair work standards.The post Lib Dems Urge Major Boost for Scotland’s Gaming Industry appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: FOI Reveals £843,743 Spent on Scrapped ‘Brit Card’ Proposal
item.description: An FOI response has revealed £843,743 was spent on the scrapped ‘Brit Card’ proposal before it was abandoned, prompting criticism from the SNP over Westminster spending and policy reversals.The post FOI Reveals £843,743 Spent on Scrapped ‘Brit Card’ Proposal appeared first on The Highland Times.
